algorithm_long: Atomic-Affine-Bagged-QRF: Bayesian-bootstrap nonnegative affine MAE combination of 32 ExtraTrees conditional mean/median predictors, with coefficient sum at most two and free intercept. Five training-only inner folds; fixed 16 configurations, 600 inner trees and 900 final trees; reference seed 417.

notes: Composition-only. Reference seed 417 reported; seed repeats 0-6 give 75.77 +/- 0.33 MPa mean fold MAE (all in all_seed_scores.csv). The official folds were reused during method development, so selection across runs may be optimistic; each run fits only on outer-training labels. Exact rebuild requires CPython 3.13.16 and requirements.txt; reproduce_entry.py and the notebook rebuild all forests from raw inputs and check the fold dictionaries against results.json.gz exactly.
